description: Short-term accommodations for students recovering from injuries, surgeries, or acute medical events
specific_accommodations: Temporary remote attendance during recovery period
One-time extension of up to 2 weeks on major assignments
Accessible seating near exits or elevators
Use of elevator in buildings where typically restricted
Assistance with heavy textbooks or materials
Excused absences for medical appointments and recovery
documentation_required: Doctor's note with estimated recovery timeline
notes: This is a temporary accommodation. Re-evaluation required if recovery extends beyond initial timeline.
